label: JavaScript UDF library
type: a named collection of JavaScript function definitions, created global or scoped (js-udf:global-function / js-udf:scoped-function), that a SQL++ CREATE FUNCTION statement (js-udf:external-function) references by name. Distinct from js-udf:sql-managed-udf, which needs no library at all.
recurrence_note: 6 files, `divergent` - discount rejected, raw count stands.
evidence: A JavaScript library can be global or scoped.
Before you can delete a library, you must first drop all SQL++ user-defined functions which point to any of the JavaScript functions within that library.
relates_to_competency_question: How does a SQL++ CREATE FUNCTION statement find the JavaScript code it should run, and can a library be deleted while functions still reference it?
